sections.description: A self-hosted Critical CSS generator. Add the [mbr_critical_css] shortcode to any page: your server fetches the target page and its stylesheets, and the visitor's own browser renders it at the chosen viewport and extracts the above-the-fold CSS, then checks the result against the full render. Works on shared hosting, with no Node.js or headless Chrome. No premium tier, no upsells, no tracking, GPL licensed.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Self-hosted updates through Plugin Update Checker, so new versions appear on the Plugins screen.

1.2.0

  • CSS is now processed with a tokenizer: only real url(), image-set() and @import references are rewritten, never text inside strings or comments.
  • The processing budget is charged as output is written, with URL-length and reference limits, a memory guard, and deadline checks throughout.
  • The preview's Content Security Policy allows images and fonts only from hosts that passed server-side checks, including after redirects.
  • srcset is parsed exactly as browsers parse it.
  • Hidden-element rules keep their custom properties; interaction states inside :not() no longer break selectors.
  • The fidelity check is now a layout & style check covering position, size, visibility, colours, backgrounds, borders and fonts.

1.1.0

  • Security and accuracy release following an independent code audit: job budgets and deadline, atomic rate limiting, a cap on simultaneous jobs, full-origin checks and a restricted preview.
  • Rules that keep hidden or off-screen elements in place are kept; @import conditions and stylesheet redirects are handled correctly; fonts and keyframes stay in their original wrappers.
  • New fidelity check comparing a critical-only render with the full page.

1.0.2

  • Fixed the results area overflowing on wide viewports.

1.0.1

  • Fixed theme iframe rules shrinking the measuring frame; better minification; clearer stats.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it. Add the [mbr_critical_css] shortcode to any page, and adjust access, rate limiting and simultaneous jobs under Settings → Critical CSS Generator.
